in_marathi.name: Dheeksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dheekshati’ which means ‘to ask, to seek, to request’. This name symbolizes the journey of seeking spiritual growth, knowledge, and enlightenment.
